## Checklist

- [ ] The [verification gates](https://github.com/Nickelony/Stanza/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#verification) pass locally.
- [ ] The change is focused: one rule, one fix or one documentation change.
- [ ] A rule change follows the [rule checklist](https://github.com/Nickelony/Stanza/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-or-changing-a-rule).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an `Unreleased` entry (user-visible changes only).
- [ ] Each page that the change makes wrong is updated, and the docs follow [STYLEGUIDE.md](https://github.com/Nickelony/Stanza/blob/main/STYLEGUIDE.md).
